title: Python Developer
description: Design, build, and maintain scalable server-side applications, microservices, and RESTful APIs using Python, FastAPI or Django, with robust database integrations, asynchronous processing, and automated unit testing.
interview_topics: Python Data Structures and Memory Management
Asynchronous Programming with asyncio in Python
Building and Documenting RESTful APIs with FastAPI
Database Modeling, Relational Integrity & ORMs
Unit Testing, Mocking, and Dependency Injection
career_suitability_summary: Ideal for developers who enjoy writing clean, readable code and building high-performance backend APIs and asynchronous services.

title: Java Developer
description: Develop and maintain robust, high-volume enterprise services, REST microservices, and secure distributed backend systems using modern Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, and relational databases.
interview_topics: Core Java OOP Concepts, Collections, Multithreading
Spring Boot Dependency Injection and Inversion of Control
JPA and Hibernate Transaction Management
Microservice Resiliency and API Design
JUnit Testing and Mockito Verification
career_suitability_summary: Suited for engineers who want to work on large-scale banking, telecom, or enterprise distributed applications.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Architect and deliver end-to-end web applications combining intuitive, responsive client interfaces in React.js with reliable, high-throughput backend services and secure database operations.

learning_resources.title: The Odin Project - Full Stack JavaScript

interview_topics: JavaScript Event Loop, Closures, and Async/Await
React Component Lifecycle, State Management, and Hooks
Building Secure Authentication (JWT, Cookies, Sessions)
Database Schema Design & Query Optimization
Full Stack Deployment, CI/CD, and Web Performance
career_suitability_summary: Perfect for versatile problem solvers who love crafting user-friendly interfaces as much as robust server-side logic.

title: Frontend Developer
description: Create pixel-perfect, accessible, and ultra-responsive user interfaces for modern web applications using React.js, modern JavaScript/TypeScript, and utility-first styling frameworks.

learning_resources.title: MDN Web Docs - Frontend Web Developer

interview_topics: DOM Manipulation, Browser Rendering Pipeline, and Core Web Vitals
React Component Composition, Custom Hooks, and Virtual DOM
State Management (Context API vs Redux Toolkit)
Cross-browser Responsive Design and Web Accessibility (WCAG)
Client-side Routing, Code-Splitting, and Asset Optimization
career_suitability_summary: Ideal for creative coders who care deeply about design fidelity, user experience, and slick interactive animations.

title: Backend Developer
description: Architect and optimize backend infrastructure, robust data storage tiers, REST & GraphQL endpoints, authentication gateways, and caching systems with high availability and security in mind.
interview_topics: Relational vs NoSQL Database Selection and Indexing
API Security: OAuth2, JWT, Rate Limiting, and CORS
Caching Strategies with Redis (Write-through vs Cache-aside)
Database Transactions, Isolation Levels, and ACID Guarantees
Containerization with Docker and Microservice Communication
career_suitability_summary: Tailored for engineers who enjoy system architecture, database performance tuning, server security, and data consistency.

title: Data Analyst
description: Transform messy raw datasets into actionable commercial insights by authoring complex SQL queries, building interactive analytical dashboards, performing statistical analysis, and visualizing data trends.

learning_resources.title: Data Visualization with Seaborn and Matplotlib

interview_topics: Advanced SQL: Window Functions, CTEs, Joins, Group By
Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) Workflow with Pandas
Handling Missing Data, Outliers, and Data Cleaning Strategies
Statistical Concepts: Mean, Median, Variance, P-value, Distributions
Translating Business Questions into Quantitative Visual Metrics
career_suitability_summary: Great for analytical thinkers who love discovering trends, crafting clear visual reports, and driving business decisions through data.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Design, train, evaluate, and deploy predictive machine learning and deep learning models into production environments, utilizing state-of-the-art NLP, feature engineering, and model serving pipelines.

learning_resources.title: Fast.ai - Practical Deep Learning for Coders

interview_topics: Supervised vs Unsupervised Learning Algorithms & Tradeoffs
Feature Engineering, Regularization (L1/L2), and Overfitting
Evaluation Metrics: Precision, Recall, F1-Score, ROC-AUC, RMSE
Model Deployment Pipelines (REST API serving with FastAPI and Docker)
Neural Network Architecture, Activation Functions, and Backpropagation
career_suitability_summary: Best for software engineers with strong mathematical intuition who want to build smart algorithms and AI features.

title: Software Tester
description: Ensure high software quality and reliability across web and API applications by designing comprehensive test cases, executing automated end-to-end testing, verifying API contracts, and diagnosing defects.

learning_resources.title: Software Testing Methodologies and QA Fundamentals

interview_topics: Test Pyramid: Unit, Integration, System, and Acceptance Testing
Writing Robust Automation Scripts with Selenium WebDriver and Page Object Model
API Testing Strategies: Status codes, Payloads, Header validations, Schema checks
Defect Life Cycle, Severity vs Priority, and Test Reporting
Performance and Load Testing basics using JMeter
career_suitability_summary: Excels for detail-oriented professionals passionate about finding edge cases, building automated regression suites, and ensuring bug-free software releases.
